projects.title: Branchi — fictional example
projects.prompt: FICTIONAL WALKTHROUGH: plan a friendly project companion called Branchi. Keep the purpose clear, compare simple setup options, and help a new user pick up where they left off. This example contains no real user projects or captured conversations.

criteria.text: Explain the purpose in everyday language
Show connected work and alternative ideas
Make the first five minutes easy to follow

nodes.detail: Keep the original goal, useful decisions and one next action together.
nodes.evidence: Fictional demonstration record; not a real project result.

nodes.title: Start with people juggling several projects
nodes.detail: Focus the introduction on returning to work after a break.

nodes.alternatives: Configure every integration at the start.
